review:
Marlin Masters Atlantis takes the fishing collect formula underwater. Marlin symbols carry cash values, and Jackpot Marlins reveal one of four jackpots, the top one being the max win. Either can be won through a LootLine of three or more symbols, or by a Fisherman, who collects everything and can carry a multiplier of up to x20.

Two bonus games, starting with Sunken Empire, keep Fishermen coming. If you've played other fishing slots, this is a familiar formula, but the LootLine route gives you a second way to cash in values without a collector. The cap is 10,000x.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
